comparison.objective: Release a safety loop and open a bottle lid while keeping the bottle upright; candidate depins a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: External detent/latch actuation and lid rotation versus constrained insertion around a recessed contact, two-tang depression, and opposing pull.
comparison.success_condition: Requires sufficient lid angle without tipping or excessive force; candidate requires terminal exit, neighbor retention, and reusable housing. Candidate extraction-force limits are missing.
comparison.reason: An external bottle latch does not test selective internal contact extraction.
